data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2255 experienced a gross prior year reserve release of GBP 17.123 million in 2015, primarily driven by favorable claims development on the 2011 underwriting year. This release represents a 6.73% reduction in opening gross reserves. The report notes benign claims development across most classes of Syndicate 1861's business, including Primary Excess of Loss and Single Job Construction. A key area of uncertainty remains the material exposure to the 2001 World Trade Center terrorist attacks, with the ultimate value of claims dependent on ongoing litigation.
